mio_icif.ponder.armory.header: Store and summon suits with the Armory
mio_icif.ponder.armory.text_1: The Armory stores six suits. Each suit has six pieces: four armor pieces and two hand items.
mio_icif.ponder.armory.text_2: Supply power to the Armory. The first player who opens a powered Armory becomes its owner.
mio_icif.ponder.armory.text_3: A Holo Display Projector next to the Armory adds suit positions. It shows its suit as a hologram.
mio_icif.ponder.armory.text_4: Pair an Armory Remote with the Armory. Then use the Singularity Management Panel to summon a suit, to deploy a Wingman or to equip a companion.
mio_icif.ponder.nuclear_reactor.text_1: The Nuclear Reactor Generator makes EU and heat from fuel rods. Without chambers, it has three columns of slots.
mio_icif.ponder.nuclear_reactor.text_2: Each Reactor Chamber on a side of the generator adds one column of slots. The maximum is six chambers.
mio_icif.ponder.nuclear_reactor.text_3: Do a check of each design in the Reactor Simulator page of the manual before you put fuel rods in the reactor.
mio_icif.ponder.nuclear_reactor.text_4: WARNING: A reactor with too much hull heat explodes. The explosion destroys the blocks near it.
mio_icif.ponder.blueprint_builder.text_1: The Blueprint Builder has four drones. The drones place the blocks of a blueprint, one block at a time.
mio_icif.ponder.blueprint_builder.text_2: Put an Armory Material Interface within 16 blocks. The drones take material from it and from the storages next to it.
mio_icif.ponder.blueprint_builder.text_3: Load a Create schematic or a file of the schematics folder. The hologram shows the work area.
mio_icif.ponder.blueprint_builder.text_4: The drones place the bottom layer first. They do not break blocks: a position with a different block is skipped.
mio_icif.ponder.ejector_pipe.header: Eject items and fluids into the world
mio_icif.ponder.ejector_pipe.text_1: Put the Ejector Pipe on a container. The nozzle points away from the container.
mio_icif.ponder.ejector_pipe.text_2: The pipe takes up to 16 items from the container and throws them out of the nozzle every 8 ticks.
mio_icif.ponder.ejector_pipe.text_3: With one full bucket of fluid, the pipe puts a source block in front of the nozzle. A redstone signal stops the pipe.

module.mio_icif.myofiber.desc: Artificial muscle fibre woven into the leggings. Sprint +15 %, steps up one block. Burst: Kinetic Dash, an 8-block horizontal dash (no fall damage). With an active nanosaber in hand: HF sync, attack speed +12 % and light armour penetration.
module.mio_icif.thermoregulator.desc: A heat-pump membrane under the chest plates. No freezing (powder snow, cold), fire damage -50 %, lava -30 %. The nano core sheds heat twice as fast.
module.mio_icif.emp_emitter.desc: Burst: an electromagnetic pulse of 6 blocks. Erases hostile projectiles in flight, lets creeper fuses fall back, stuns mechanical creatures for 3 s and breaks the guidance locks on you. Ends your optical camouflage. Breaks no blocks.
module.mio_icif.optical_camo.desc: Sustained burst: the nano coat bends light around you for up to 15 s (6 reserve per second). Creatures lose sight of you beyond 2.5 blocks. Attacking, being hit or an EMP ends it. Press the key again to switch it off.
module.mio_icif.toxin_filter.desc: Nano filter in the helmet intake. Poison and wither do not take hold; radiation -60 %. Fits nano and quantum helmets.
module.mio_icif.micro_capacitor.desc: Capacitor cells grown into the nano lattice: +250 000 EU storage in this piece. Passive, no switch.

module.mio_icif.gecko_setae.desc: Microscopic setae on the boot soles. Sneak into a wall to climb it; sneak against a wall to slide down slowly. No slow-down on soul sand, honey or powder snow; grip on ice.
module.mio_icif.shock_gel.desc: Non-Newtonian gel in the boots. The fall protection of the nano boots costs 70 % less EU, and a jump right after a landing rebounds 50 % higher.
module.mio_icif.heat_sink_fins.desc: Fold-out fins on the chest or legs. Heat cap +50 per fin unit, and an overheat no longer slows you.
module.mio_icif.thermal_camo.desc: The coat cools to the ambient temperature. While sneaking, creatures notice you at half the distance.
module.mio_icif.jammer.desc: Broadband jamming from the helmet. Hostile creatures beyond 12 blocks lose track of you, and guided weapons cannot lock you.
module.mio_icif.recon_cloud.desc: Burst: a swarm of nano sensors spreads 24 blocks ahead. The creatures in it glow for you for 10 s, through walls, without a visor.
module.mio_icif.kinetic_mesh.desc: Burst: the nano weave locks into hexagonal plates for 6 s and cuts a further 30 % of the damage (total absorption at most 95 %). The weave also syncs with an active nanosaber (HF sync).
module.mio_icif.self_repair.desc: After 5 s without damage, the nano coat mends you: 0.5 health every 3 s, 2 000 EU each. Fits nano and quantum pieces.
module.mio_icif.hydrophobic.desc: Water beads off the coat: no water drag, swimming +30 %. Fits nano and quantum pieces.
module.mio_icif.kinetic_generator.desc: Harvests the stride: 1 EU per block walked, 2 EU per block sprinted, into the suit. Works with an empty suit. Fits nano and quantum leggings.
module.mio_icif.solar_skin.desc: Photovoltaic coat: 2 EU/t under open daylight. Works with an empty suit.
module.mio_icif.myofiber.desc.mk2: Mk.II: sprint +22 %, dash 10 blocks, HF sync counts double.
module.mio_icif.thermoregulator.desc.mk2: Mk.II: fire -70 %, lava -50 %, heat sheds x2.5.
module.mio_icif.emp_emitter.desc.mk2: Mk.II: radius 8 blocks, stun 4.5 s, a violet wave.
module.mio_icif.optical_camo.desc.mk2: Mk.II: up to 22 s, 4.5 reserve per second.
module.mio_icif.toxin_filter.desc.mk2: Mk.II: radiation -85 %; hunger and nausea filtered too.
module.mio_icif.gecko_setae.desc.mk2: Mk.II: climbs faster and clings to walls without sliding.
module.mio_icif.heat_sink_fins.desc.mk2: Mk.II: heat cap +75, heat sheds 25 % faster.
module.mio_icif.thermal_camo.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 30 % detection while sneaking, 75 % while walking.
module.mio_icif.jammer.desc.mk2: Mk.II: creatures lose track beyond 8 blocks.
module.mio_icif.recon_cloud.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 32 blocks all around, glow for 15 s.

module.mio_icif.kinetic_generator.desc.m: Mk.II: 2 EU per block walked, 4 sprinted.

core.mio_icif.solar_array_2.desc: A solar panel with two folding wings. Charges under open sky: the suit first, then your equipment.
core.mio_icif.solar_array_3.desc: A sun crown: wings, a sun core on the brow and a solar fan. Charges under open sky: the suit first, then your equipment.
core.mio_icif.graviton.desc: Gravity anchor: no fall damage, no knockback and no blast push. Armour +1. Emergency repair below 20 % health: 1 health per tick for 5,000 EU.
core.mio_icif.propulsion.desc: Twin boosters and a reactor: +90,000,000 EU, no flight ceiling, thrust +15 %, sharper maneuver vectoring, armour +1, knockback resistance +0.5, repair 2.0 health/s (30,000 EU/s).

mio_icif.configuration.scan_fx.tooltip: A scan sphere expands from you every 3 s while an entity sensor unit runs.
mio_icif.configuration.wingman_fx.toolti: Lock-on scan laser and hologram marker, muzzle flashes, thruster boosts, attitude jets and slash arcs.
module.mio_icif.phase_jump_drive.desc: Folds the space ahead of the suit. Action: Quantum Blink, a jump to the point you look at (12 blocks), never through walls; no fall damage right after it.
module.mio_icif.phase_modulator.desc: Shifts the suit out of phase with matter. Action: Phase Shift, 1 s in which creature, projectile and blast damage passes through you; no attacks or mining meanwhile. Lava, fire, drowning and the void still hurt.
module.mio_icif.phase_modulator.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 1.5 s, and a shock wave when it ends.
module.mio_icif.coherence_capacitor.desc: Stores quantum coherence for the actions: maximum +50, regeneration +25 %. Passive.
module.mio_icif.entanglement_relay.desc: Entangles the suit with your Wingmen. Action: Entangled Volley, every Wingman in this dimension fires at your Smart Guidance locks (or the creature you look at) and all bolts strike at the same moment.
module.mio_icif.deflector.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 3,000 EU per damage point. Action: Force Field, a dome that stops hostile projectiles in the air and pushes hostile creatures out (toggle).
Mk.II: Action: Time Dilation, a field that slows hostile creatures and projectiles around you for 4 s while you move faster. Data link: the paths of nearby creatures follow the route they really walk (LINK).

mio_icif.configuration.visor_boot.toolti: The FCS visor boots when the HUD comes on: scan line, panels, aim calibration.
mio_icif.configuration.quantum_fx_intens: Strength of the blink, phase, field, dilation and volley effects.
mio_icif.configuration.decoherence_glitc: The HUD tears and splits colours while the quantum core decoheres. Off: a calm warning.
module.mio_icif.compute_core.desc: A second processor for the suit computer: compute bandwidth +8 QB and one more entanglement link on the chestplate. 6 EU/t while on.
module.mio_icif.ore_scanner.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 24-block radius; an ore tag filter in the Singularity Management Panel (all ores or one c:ores tag).
module.mio_icif.grid_telemetry.desc.mk2: Mk.II: reads the block in your line of sight up to 36 blocks away (Mk.I: the block in reach).
module.mio_icif.entity_esp.desc.mk2: Mk.II: 48 blocks; the target card also shows the exact health and the armor.
module.mio_icif.ballistic.desc.mk2: Mk.II: a multishot weapon shows the paths of all three shots.
module.mio_icif.smart_guidance.desc.mk2: Mk.II: up to 10 locks; guided shots turn up to 20 degrees per tick; locks behind cover are kept for 2 s (Mk.I: 6 locks, 14 degrees, 1 s).
module.mio_icif.resonance_field.desc.mk2: Mk.II: radius 3.75 and up to 9 blocks per tick (Mk.I: radius 2.5, 6 blocks).
module.mio_icif.tooltip.bandwidth: Compute bandwidth: %s QB on a quantum piece
quantum.mio_icif.synergy.predictive_guid: Guided shots fly to where the target will be: along the path a creature walks, solved in three passes. Turn +4 degrees per tick, 2 more locks.
quantum.mio_icif.synergy.threat_sight.de: Creatures that hunt you glow red through walls, with a ring that counts down to their attack.
quantum.mio_icif.synergy.ore_holo.desc: The ores of the seismic scan appear as 3D voxels in the holomap and the tactical map.

gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.title: Settlement container
gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.help: A shulker box, a backpack, an AE2 storage cell or a container of UU-matter. Its items sell and deliver like the items you carry. It comes back to you when you close the panel.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.no_commodit: Nothing in it sells as a commodity.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.sell_now_he: Sells the commodities of the container now, each in one batch: every item paid at least the minimum, within your daily allowance. What the market does not take at the minimum stays in the container.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.buy_help: Buys the market selected on the Market tab now (price limit and quantity of the order ticket), paid with the coins you carry. The items go into the container; what does not fit goes to your inventory, then to the mailbox.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.settle.no_targets: No bounty or commission needs its items.
message.mio_icif.exchange.settle_empty: Put a container into the settlement slot.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.no_owner: No owner: the terminal does nothing
gui.mio_icif.terminal.owner_help: Your access: %s. Energy %s / %s EU. Every trade is the owner's: the coins go to and come from the owner's mailbox. Green: the owner is online; yellow: offline (only the daily auction runs).
gui.mio_icif.terminal.sell_buffer_help: Pipes and hoppers put commodities in here (also items of a commodity's tag). Pipes cannot take anything out. The sell orders sell from it.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.settle_help: A container of yours: sell its commodities as yourself, put its UU-matter on your account, load it into the sell buffer, or unload the output buffer into it.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.settle_quote_help: What the container's commodities would pay you now, and at the daily auction if the day changed now.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.load_help: Moves the container's commodities into the sell buffer. They then belong to the terminal and are sold for its owner.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.unload_help: Moves the output buffer into the container (configure access).
gui.mio_icif.terminal.output_help: On: purchases go to the output buffer (pipes take them out) and the buy orders count its stock. Off: purchases go to the owner's mailbox and the buy orders count the mailbox.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.orders_help: The orders run every 10 seconds as trades of the owner, under the same rules as manual trades. While the owner is offline only the auction sell orders run (not for commodities that need an unlock). Instant sales and purchases trade in batches of 64.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.0: The order traded in the last run.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.2: Nothing above the kept amount, or the stock is at the target.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.3: Waits for the owner: while the owner is offline only auction sell orders run, and not for commodities that need an unlock.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.4: The owner has not unlocked this commodity.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.5: The terminal lacks the energy of a trade.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.6: The owner's mailbox has not enough coins for one item at the price limit.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.7: Not a datapack commodity of the market (any more).
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.8: The market does not trade at the price limit now.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.mode_help: Auction: the items join the owner's daily auction order (also while the owner is offline). Instant: sold at once down the bid curve at the minimum price (only while the owner is online).
gui.mio_icif.terminal.item_help: Scroll or use the arrows to pick the commodity.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.access_help: Only the owner edits the access list and the team level.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.no_access: Only the owner (and operators) may use the terminal.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.team_help: The access of players in the owner's scoreboard team.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.levels_help: View: open and see. Trade: fill the sell buffer, use the settlement slot as yourself. Configure: orders, output mode, take items out of the buffers. Operators count as Configure.
message.mio_icif.exchange.terminal.denie: Your access to this terminal does not allow that.
message.mio_icif.exchange.terminal.order: A terminal holds at most %s orders.
message.mio_icif.exchange.terminal.no_pl: No player named %s is known to the server.
message.mio_icif.exchange.terminal.acces: The access list holds at most %s players.
message.mio_icif.exchange.terminal.nothi: Nothing to move, or no room.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.status_help.9: Waits for a batch: an instant sale for 64 items above the kept amount (or a full buffer), a purchase until 64 are missing (or the whole target when it is smaller). Every trade rounds its coins, so one-item trades would lose value.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.buy_into_help: Buys the commodity now as yourself (price limit and quantity), paid with the coins you carry; the items go into the container, the rest to your inventory, then your mailbox.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.uu_board_help: Players trade UU-matter for coins here: one unit is 100 mB of the UU account, the price is in coins per 100 mB. A sale holds UU-matter of your account, a purchase puts it there. The market itself never buys or sells UU-matter.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.scrap_help: When the market pays almost nothing for what a sale leaves (the next bid below 5 %% of the price, or below 1 coin), the rest goes to the recycler instead: scrap at the IC2 recycler's rate (1 for 8 items; items with a recycler recipe give its product). The coins of the sale do not change.
message.mio_icif.exchange.box_sold_scrap: Sold %s items for %s coins; %s items recycled into %s scrap
gui.mio_icif.exchange.stabilizer_help: When the coins the market created in the last 7 days (minus those it destroyed) pass the target, the sell depths and the daily allowance shrink a step a day; below 80 %% of the target they grow back. Target: per player who sold in those days, or a share of the money supply (estimate %s) when that is more. Active sellers: %s.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.scrap_week: Scrap sink, 7 days: %s items in, %s scrap out

message.mio_icif.card.status.wrong_issue: This card of %s (%s, %s days) does not apply here.
message.mio_icif.exchange.card.self: You need no card for yourself: you own the terminal.
message.mio_icif.exchange.card.full: At most %s delegate cards can be open at once; revoke one first.
message.mio_icif.exchange.card.no_blank: Carry a blank ID card to write it.
message.mio_icif.exchange.card.issued: Delegate card written for %s, valid for %s days.
gui.mio_icif.card.title: Exchange account
gui.mio_icif.card.mail: Account: %s coins, %s mB UU-matter, mailbox %s items
gui.mio_icif.card.remote_help: From afar refunds go to the mailbox; collect them at a Futures Machine.
gui.mio_icif.card.no_cards: None. Write delegate cards at your Trade Terminal (Cards page).
gui.mio_icif.card.cards_help: A revoked card stops working at once, wherever it is.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.cards_help: A delegate card gives its holder the written level at all your terminals until its last day. It works only for that player; you can revoke it at any time (here or on your personal card).
gui.mio_icif.terminal.cards_owner_only: Only the owner writes and revokes delegate cards.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.card_write_help: Needs a blank ID card in your inventory; the written card goes to your inventory, hand it to the player.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.cards_foot: A card in the wrong hands does nothing: it works only for the player it was written for.
gui.mio_icif.terminal.order_sell_scrap: Keep %s, sell rest now, scrap the unsold (min %s)

gui.mio_icif.exchange.account_help: Your coins at the exchange. Sales that do not fit the inventory land here; purchases, buy orders, commission rewards and fees and futures collateral take from the inventory and this account together (in bank mode from the account first).
gui.mio_icif.exchange.coin_amount_help: Coins to deposit or withdraw (0 = all)
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bank_help: Bank mode: the coins of sales and payouts go to the coin account instead of the inventory, payments take from the account first, and Collect leaves the coins there (Withdraw takes them). Off: the inventory first, the account for the rest.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.pay_from: Pays from: %s coins carried + %s on the account
gui.mio_icif.terminal.coins_in_help: The coins of the container onto your coin account.
message.mio_icif.exchange.coins_withdraw: %s coins taken from the coin account
message.mio_icif.exchange.bank_mode_on: Bank mode on: sales go to the coin account, payments take from it first
message.mio_icif.exchange.bank_mode_off: Bank mode off: sales go to the inventory, payments take from it first
message.mio_icif.exchange.too_fast: Too many actions at once - wait a moment and try again
gui.mio_icif.exchange.box.min_toggle_hel: Switch the minimum between percent of the bid without pressure and coins per item.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.box.min_help: Sell now: of each commodity the most items whose own price is still at least the minimum, in one batch at the summed price (one payout). Auction: the lowest average. 0 = no minimum.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.percent_toggle_hel: Name the limit of a sale in coins (c) or in percent of the bid without pressure (%%). A percent becomes coins with the price at the time of the sale.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.ticket_estimate_he: Every item the market takes is paid at least %1$s coins (last item %2$s, next %3$s), one payout for the batch. Resting bids of players are not counted.
mio_icif.configuration.suit_glow.tooltip: Nano and quantum suits glow in their light colour: amber and red as the charge falls, breathing, an energy band and a power-on sweep.
mio_icif.configuration.suit_glow_strengt: Strength of the suit glow. 1.0 = default.
mio_icif.configuration.motion_fx.tooltip: Quantum suit in normal mode: back and sole jets in jetpack flight, the take-off ring of a boost jump, the shock ring of a hard landing, the air streaks of the sprint. Also the ion trail, re-entry glow and seam light of Armory pieces.
mio_icif.configuration.visor_glass.toolt: Off by default. In first person with a nano or quantum helmet: a faint rim, colour fringes, a reflection that slides as you turn, raindrops in the rain, cracks when the helmet is almost empty.
message.mio_icif.projector.mode_physical: Physical display: the real gear on the cradle
mio_icif.configuration.hit_ripple: Armour hit ripple and suit boot
mio_icif.configuration.hit_ripple.toolti: A hexagonal ring of light runs over a quantum suit from where a hit was absorbed. When the Armory locks the last piece, the suit boots: light from the chest core, the visor from its centre, a ring from the core.
mio_icif.configuration.suit_gimmicks.too: Quantum suit: the back vents slide open and glow in flight, the shoulder plates slide back while sprinting, the visor lights from its centre when it comes on.
mio_icif.configuration.armory_fx.tooltip: The iris hatch of the Armory, the icons of its suits and its maintenance rings; the transfer gates of summons from far away.
mio_icif.configuration.fx_lod.tooltip: Fewer segments and no afterimages beyond 24 blocks, only the light beyond 64.
mio_icif.configuration.fx_budget.tooltip: Most whole-body effect passes a frame (hit ripples, hologram grids, nano mesh); the nearest are drawn.
gui.mio_icif.preview.title: 3D preview
gui.mio_icif.exchange.day_help: The market's day. It goes on with the days that pass in the world; when the world's time is set back it still goes on by one day (records, bounties and orders keep their dates).
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_floor_help: A bounty needs this item: the market sells it at %1$s or more (the bounty's reward per item), so buying here to deliver does not pay.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.below_band: Under the band (%1$s): sold now to the market only
gui.mio_icif.exchange.below_band_rest: Under the band (%1$s): an order cannot rest here
gui.mio_icif.exchange.below_band_help: Orders in the book stay within %1$s - %2$s. An instant sale to the market may name a lower limit; it is paid what the market's bid pays.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.positions_help: At most %1$s open futures of up to %2$s items each; a position settles on its last day at the market price.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.commission_lot_hel: Delivered in lots of %1$s items; each lot pays %2$s
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_deliver: §aDelivered %1$s items; %2$s coins paid now. Still needed: %3$s
message.mio_icif.exchange.commission_lot: §cThis commission takes whole lots of %1$s items (each pays %2$s), or all that is left.
command.mio_icif.market_tools.day: Market day %1$s; world day %2$s (last seen %3$s); latest record day %4$s
command.mio_icif.market_tools.day_repair: Market day repaired: %1$s -> %2$s; %3$s records moved with it.
command.mio_icif.market_tools.day_ok: Market day %1$s is not behind any record; nothing to repair.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.more_help: Scroll the list with the mouse wheel
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.rarity_help: The rarity sets how long a bounty stays open: common 3-7 days, uncommon 2-5, rare 1-4, legendary 1-3; a large request gets at least 1 day more for each doubling of its value above 4,000 coins.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.rush_help: Posted for fewer than 4 days: the rewards are %1$s%% higher (5 for each day below 4).
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.claim_help: Claim this bounty for you and your team: nobody else can deliver to it. You hold one claim at a time; a claim with one day left gets one more day. Special bounties and bounties someone already delivered to cannot be claimed.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.abandon_hel: Give up the claim: everybody may deliver to the bounty again, and you cannot claim another one until the next market day.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.claimed_hel: %1$s claimed this bounty: only they and their team deliver to it. The claim ends when it is given up, when the bounty ends, or after two whole market days away.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.claimed_tea: Your teammate %1$s claimed this bounty: you can deliver to it too.
gui.mio_icif.exchange.bounty.refresh_hel: Replaces the %1$s normal requests that nobody claimed or delivered to with new ones (never the same items). The coins are destroyed. Refreshes left today: %2$s. Cost now: %3$s coins (500, or 5 per 100 coins of their rewards when that is more; doubled for each refresh you made today; five minutes apart).
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_claimed: §c%1$s claimed this bounty: only they and their team deliver to it.
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_claim_s: §cSomeone already delivered to this bounty: it can no longer be claimed.
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_claim_l: §cYou hold as many claims as you may: finish or abandon one first.
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_claim_b: §cYou gave up a claim this market day: you can claim again on the next one.
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_claim_d: §aClaimed: only you and your team deliver to it (%1$s days left).
message.mio_icif.exchange.bounty_abandon: §eClaim given up: you can claim again on the next market day.
